For a church worship service, I recommend a projector that is bright enough to display song lyrics, Bible verses, sermon slides, and videos clearly—even when the sanctuary lights are on.

What to look for

Feature

	

Recommendation




Brightness

	

5,000–7,000 ANSI lumens for most churches




Resolution

	

Full HD (1080p) or WUXGA




Light source

	

Laser preferred for low maintenance




Installation

	

Ceiling-mounted with lens shift




Connectivity

	

HDMI, preferably HDBaseT for long cable runs




Throw distance

	

Depends on screen size and projector placement

For a small church, 4,000–5,000 lumens may be sufficient. For a large sanctuary with substantial ambient light, consider 7,000–10,000+ lumens.
